3.title: CBT - Cognitive Restructuring
3.goal: Techniques for identifying and challenging negative thought patterns to alter emotional responses and behaviors. Focuses on examining evidence, reattributing blame, and considering alternative perspectives.
keyConcepts: Identifying Cognitive Distortions: recognizing patterns like all-or-nothing thinking, catastrophizing, and overgeneralization
Examine the evidence for and against your thoughts to develop a more balanced perspective.
Substitute distorted thoughts with healthier, more realistic alternatives that support well-being.

books.title: CBT - Cognitive Restructuring (Challenging Thoughts)
books.summary: A practical guide to cognitive restructuring techniques, including exercises and real-life applications.

3.title: Parenting a Child with Emotional or Behavioral Disorder
3.goal: To equip parents, teachers, and counselors with practical tools and understanding to effectively support and nurture children with emotional or behavioral disorders in home and school settings.
keyConcepts: Consistent Structure and Routines: Creating a predictable environment helps children feel secure and reduces anxiety.
Collaborative Support Systems: Involving parents, teachers, and mental health professionals to create a network of support.
Positive Behavior Reinforcement: Encouraging desired behaviors through praise and rewards, rather than focusing solely on negative behaviors.

books.title: Parenting a Child with Emotional or Behavioral Disorder
books.author: Mary M. Wood
books.summary: This book provides practical strategies and compassionate guidance to help caregivers and educators support children with emotional or behavioral disorders through consistent structure, collaboration, and positive reinforcement.
